text.en:
The expenditures made during the period from July first to December thirty-first, nineteen hundred
seventy-three pursuant to appropriations made by law prior to this Decree, of the income accruing to the
general, special, trust, and other funds in the Philippine Treasury for the said period is hereby authorized:
Provided, however, That the expenditures from special and trust funds for the purposes for which said special
and trust funds were created.

All laws, decrees, orders, rules and regulations or parts thereof inconsistent herewith are hereby
repealed or modified accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 18th day of December, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-four.
